title: Outdoor plaza with modern multi-storey building and metallic sphere in background

A multi-storey building with a large metallic spherical structure in its upper levels is visible in the background across the entire image width.

At least eight vertical lamp posts or streetlights are visible at various distances across the scene (several are partially obscured by trees; counted distinct visible posts: one far left, three in the midground row, one large post at right foreground, plus others visible near center and background).
One long bench-like structure dominates the foreground center and appears intact and unobscured; it has a slatted front face.

Three short cylindrical bollards are visible near the foreground left of the bench (two clearly visible, a third partially visible behind chain), and one additional short bollard is visible immediately left of the bench (total distinctly visible bollards: three).
One blue pedestrian crossing sign mounted on a pole is visible to the right of center at roughly mid-height of the image.
Multiple large trees form a continuous tree line in the midground; the exact number cannot be determined from this single view because of overlap and partial occlusion.
Several rectangular planters with plants and flowers are visible along the walkway in the midground (at least three distinct white planters are observable).
A cylindrical trash bin or receptacle is visible to the right of the bench near the pedestrian sign (partly obscured).
Multiple vertical poles and posts (including signage poles and lighting columns) are present throughout the paved plaza area; exact total not determined due to partial occlusion and distance.
